description: Single hardware source of truth. Every parameter has value, confirmed/unconfirmed status and source. Dimensions in metres, masses in kg, angles in degrees unless specified. World tabletop z=0. Asset paths exist only in the external versioned pack.

tabletop_z_m.source: Design rule: world z=0 is the tabletop top surface (scene.py contract).

bench_height_m.source: Conflicting historical floor-to-top values 0.885 and 0.801 m; measure in lab. Rendered CAD alignment uses bench_asset_top_z_m.

bench_height_alternatives_m.source: Conflict: Aldrin scene.py comment; jenga-rl layout.py.

bench_top_size_xy_m.source: Placeholder bench in scene.py; the real Vention top size is in the Vention CAD (vention.usd) and not measured.

workstation_xy_m.source: WORKSTATION_XY in settings.py: Vention offset relative to the robot at the origin, from Aldrin's source scene.

bench_scale.source: Preserved Vention USD metersPerUnit=0.01; convert centimetre asset coordinates to metre workcell stage.

bench_asset_top_z_m.source: CAD-only datum: bench/bench.usdc SHA256 34f75072eeb8667e0479cb3573b6df546e353b483712db25dfa5af42d04c9a60; default-prim-relative VentionAssembly_393251_v88_0/imported_PANEL_B2F52AEB2A0D_804849_271/Mesh_91 world bound top 80.0594045970318 cm. Not a lab floor-to-top measurement; bench_height_m remains unconfirmed.

initial_joint_deg.source: Presentation pose; not a measured lab home pose.

placement.source: Provisional 5 mm candidate base plate on tabletop; measure real plate and base elevation

order.source: Kaleb: likely flange -> Bota -> Quick Changer -> RG2. Configurable: any permutation of bota, quick_changer, rg2 with rg2 last. Verify against the real build.

diameter_m.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~48 mm); datasheet/caliper not checked.

length_m.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~32 mm); the real stack height depends on the adapter plates used, not measured.

mass_kg.source: Kaleb's approximate figure (~0.12 kg); weigh it.

sensor_origin_along_axis_m.source: Assumed measurement frame at the mid-height of the body; Bota datasheet shows the true origin.

rate_hz.source: Simulation physics sampling rate, not a claimed real Bota output rate.

wrench_topic.source: Preserves existing twin topic. Bota driver topic not pinned in Max sources; remap/configure after lab topic inventory.

wrench_type.source: Existing twin publisher; wrench_utils.py in RISL_ur.

measurement.source: Simulation reaction at Bota mount joint; not calibrated hardware output

model.value: OnRobot Quick Changer (robot side + tool side)

standoff_m.source: Aldrin CAD value (robot.py STANDOFF_M); supersedes the URDF's 15.0 mm.

mass_kg.source: Value in a robot.py comment; not weighed.

datasheet_mass_kg.source: Kaleb's figure for the official onrobot/onrobot-isaacsim RG2 (~0.78 kg); confirm on the OnRobot datasheet.

width_command_units_per_mm.source: Conflict: Max's rg_gripper.py sends the integer string straight to move_gripper in 0.1 mm units (0..1100); his README says millimetres. Code wins.

present.source: Kaleb: small add-on black finger pads.

size_m.source: Dimensions of private candidate proxy, not measured standard RG2 pads

static_friction.source: Placeholder for black rubber-like pad on wood.

mounts.source: Provisional inward pads in inspected finger frames; gap, contact face and fastening not measured

fitted.source: Proposed printed load-cell tips, not confirmed installed hardware; standard RG2 has no built-in fingertip force sensor.

range_n.source: To_buy: 500 g nominal cell range. RG2 can exceed this: mechanical overload stops and force limiting required.

topic.source: To_buy: Proposed name, std_msgs/Float32MultiArray [left_N, right_N]; does not exist on the real robot until the Arduino node is written.

model.source: To_buy: Proposed bridge-output sensor; HX711-compatible. Confirm overload margin before buying.

cell_size_m.source: Packaging envelope only; vendor drawing and hole pattern required before fabrication.

body_size_m.source: Intel D415 datasheet (99 x 20 x 23 mm) as recalled; verify on the datasheet.

color_fov_deg.source: D415 RGB FOV used by Max (camera_model.py) and by the twin's workspace camera.

resolution.source: Placeholder: RGB and aligned depth at 1280x720. Set to the profile the real pipeline uses.

offset_in_tool0_m.source: Design pose, not a lab measurement. Max's localizer_bridge.py gives (-0.012,-0.038,-0.005), but at y=-0.038 the D415 frustum is 28% blocked by the RG2 body (ray test against the pack meshes). y is moved to -0.075 so the view is clear of the RG2 with a 3 degree margin; x and z keep Max's values. Re-measure on the real bracket. Max's camera_model.py has z=-0.010; Aldrin hard-codes a D455 at wrist_3 (0.045,-0.05,0.07), a different camera and mount.

rotation_in_tool0_deg.source: Design tilt, not a lab measurement: 6 degrees about the optical X axis tilts the view away from the tool axis (toward the offset side) so the RG2 stays out of the frustum; the on-axis grasp point is visible from about 0.3 m ahead of tool0. Max's code uses identity (camera OPTICAL frame, z forward, y down, equals tool0). Extrinsic XYZ degrees. The USD camera looks along -Z, so the builder adds Rx(180) internally.

mount_position.source: Kaleb says it is now mounted UNDER the arm. Neither Max's tool0 offset (y=-38 mm) nor Aldrin's wrist_3 pose is documented as under-arm: the bracket CAD from Max is pending. Re-measure offset and rotation after the move.

bracket_size_m.source: Placeholder: Printed bracket stand-in until Max's CAD arrives.

bracket_mass_kg.source: Placeholder: Guess for a printed bracket.

camera_mass_kg.source: D415 datasheet mass as recalled (72 g).

ros_namespace.source: Proposed: realsense2_camera with camera_namespace and camera_name both set to this. Max's localizer reads the camera through pyrealsense2, not ROS topics.

calibration.value: configurable extrinsics; markerless hand-eye calibration pending
calibration.source: No calibration algorithm or measured extrinsics claimed.

position_m.source: Proposed overhead D415 optical origin, hung under the gantry beam (x = beam plane) and looking back at the tower; outside 850 mm spherical reach. Design value, not a lab measurement.

look_at_m.source: Placeholder: straight down at the tower base.

up_hint.source: Placeholder: Image up = +X (away from the robot).

color_fov_deg.source: Same D415 as the wrist camera.

calibration.source: No calibration algorithm or measured extrinsics claimed.

type.source: To_buy: 80/20 1515 gantry is the selected concept; Vention clamp remains a BOM alternative, not implemented.

extrusion_size_m.source: To_buy: 80/20 1515 series is 1.5 in x 1.5 in = 38.1 mm.

post_xy_m.source: Proposed gantry posts, standing on the bench top (pack bench footprint x -0.97..0.97, y -0.84..0.21 m) and outside the 850 mm radial reach. Design value, not a lab measurement.

removable.source: To_buy: Mounted on a quick-release base (Thorlabs KB3X3 or SmallRig Arca plate).

quick_release_base.source: To_buy: Selected camera-only detachable kinematic mount; not a load-bearing gantry base. SmallRig is an alternative.

printed_shelf_size_m.source: Placeholder: Printed camera shelf / tilt arm stand-in.

height_m.source: Design height: the beam underside rests on the release plate stacked over the shelf and camera (asset_layout.overhead_release / overhead_shelf mount_pose); overhead rails stay above the 850 mm reach. Not a lab measurement.

block_size_m.source: Kaleb work-cell requirement: 72 x 24 x 14 mm; verify physical tolerance separately.

block_mass_kg.source: Kaleb (~15 g); the fmb4 USDs author no mass (density default would give 24 g). Weigh a block.

tower_layers_built.source: Complete 54-block Jenga tower, Kaleb phase-1 scope.

static_friction.source: jenga-rl block material (0.30 static / 0.25 dynamic); calibration pending.

variation_profile.source: Provisional variation preset, not measured calibration. Replace with a measured profile name or null for nominal dimensions and scalar mass/friction.

variation_seed.source: Arbitrary reproducibility seed, not a measured hardware parameter; overwrite freely or override at build time.

variation_profiles.source: All distribution values and bounds are provisional engineering inputs, not measurements. Replace this value object after weighing blocks and measuring friction and dimensions.

bom_csv.source: Repository BOM path relative to the hardware configuration directory; preserve this layout or overwrite for portable custom configs.

mode.source: Kaleb: physics enables gravity; mirror_real disables gravity on the robot chain only.

joint_states.source: RISL_simulation simulation_node.py params; real UR driver.

trajectory_action.source: RISL_ur scripts (controller_name scaled_joint_trajectory_controller). Sim side: not implemented in phase 1 (joint states only).

value.grammar: open | close | query | <integer width in 0.1 mm, 0..1100>
